display_long_description:
Step up to the plate in **Baseball X** - a VR baseball simulator for Meta Quest that turns your room into your own batting practice stadium.

Dial in every pitch: location, speed, swing and spin. Face fastballs and breaking balls, then watch your home runs fly with realistic bat physics that make every hit feel natural.

**FEATURES**

- Batting practice, your way: full control of pitch location, speed and spin
- Realistic physics: natural swings, true ball flight and satisfying contact
- Swing analysis: track your hitting stats and replay your best hits in 3D
- Challenges and events: put your batting to the test
- For all skill levels: from first-timers to players sharpening their timing

Whether you are training to improve your batting, chasing home run records, or just want an active VR sports workout, Baseball X delivers pick-up-and-play fun with the depth to keep you swinging.

Grab your bat. Start the pitching machine. Play ball!
